title: Model Compass frozen study inputs

requiredFiles.description: Frozen registry revision used to calculate normalized attributes and scores. Root object must contain a models array.
Agent Arena headline snapshot; models array with model identity, net_pct, and median_usd fields, plus snapshot metadata.
Earlier Agent Arena snapshot used for sensitivity analysis; array of model rows with score_pct and median_usd fields.

optionalFiles.description: Fallback registry seed required only if model-registry.json is absent; it does not replace the paper's frozen registry.

parserInputs: Pinned parser outputs are included at experiments/support/intents.frozen.json and are not fetched at runtime.
provenance: Every input must be accompanied by its source, retrieval date, license or terms, and SHA-256 digest before analysis.
